name: wsproto
description: The WebSocket protocol (RFC 6455, with RFC 7692 compression) for client and server sessions, and ws:// and wss:// clients and servers over Haxe's own sockets, independent of application frameworks.
releasenote: A wss:// client whose server's certificate does not verify reports ConnectionError.CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, where it reported CONNECT_FAILED. On HashLink, a failed TLS handshake says why, where it read as Eof.
